_meta.note: durationMs here matches the `run.<id>.durationMs` field on the registered effect and the visual-duration column of motion-direction §3/§9 (not the shorter audio/cue-list.md `vibration_ms` sum). beatPatternMs is the audio pattern's beat *proportions*, uniformly scaled so the total lands on durationMs — see art/vfx/specs/rarity-reveal.md 'Why beats are scaled, not copied verbatim' for the reasoning. rawBeatPatternMs is the unscaled audio pattern, copied verbatim from audio/cue-list.md, kept here so a reviewer can see the source ratio.
